# INRAIT

> INRAIT is a boutique web engineering studio in Sofia, Bulgaria. It builds websites, online stores, booking systems and workflow/AI automation for hotels, restaurants and other service businesses in Bulgaria and the EU. Work is done directly with the founder, clients own all code and assets, and pricing starts from published estimates with a free discovery call.

The site is available in English (https://inrait.com) and Bulgarian (https://inrait.com/bg). Every page below exists in both languages; add /bg in front of the path for Bulgarian.

## Services and pricing
Starting prices are indicative estimates in EUR; final pricing is agreed after a free consultation.

- [All services and add-ons](https://inrait.com/services): interactive list of all nine services with typical timelines and add-on prices
- One-Page Website: from €350, 3-7 days
- Business Website: from €699.99, 2-4 weeks (CMS, blog, multilingual, SEO and schema add-ons)
- Custom Booking System for hospitality: from €1,199.99, 4-6 weeks (payments, SMS/email confirmations, Google Calendar sync)
- E-commerce Store: from €1,999.99, 5-8 weeks (integrated with Speedy, Econt, Stripe, PayPal)
- AI Automation: from €1,299.99, 3-6 weeks (chatbots, voice agents, document data extraction)
- Workflow Automation (n8n): from €599.99, 2-4 weeks (CRM, invoicing and lead follow-up automations)
- Visual Identity & Design: from €449.99, 2-3 weeks
- Social Media Manager: from €150 per month
- Digital Marketing Retainer: from €399 per month

## Local integrations
- [Bulgarian integrations](https://inrait.com/integrations): couriers (Econt, Speedy), payments and banks (Borica, Epay, Fibank, Postbank), accounting (Microinvest) and marketplaces (Pazaruvaj.com)

## Selected work
- [The Meridian](https://inrait.com/work/meridian): scroll-driven marketing site for a building development, with a construction timelapse and interactive floor plan
- [Barbers Unity](https://inrait.com/work/barbers-unity): full-stack booking platform for barber businesses
- [Hotel Prestige](https://inrait.com/work/hotel-prestige): full-stack hospitality website and booking
- [Aurum](https://inrait.com/work/aurum): luxury brand experience
- [EuroGuard](https://inrait.com/work/euroguard): verification tool
- [DNA of Design](https://inrait.com/work/dna-of-design): computer-vision project
- [ShiftEase](https://inrait.com/work/shiftease): productivity tool
